development_baseline.name: v12 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual (runs/adsb_v12_v2/development_residuals.parquet, nb_no_lirf_100, leave-one-month-out), floored; reproduces 332.993 / 274.585 / 198.544 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)

adsb_full.description: tools/run_adsb_full.py: LightGBM (timeline_v1 lightgbm parameters) on the timeline bundle's 276 model features plus the 27 ADS-B departure and neighbour features (pass-2 matches with 1,332 stands, data/external/adsblol/matches), target = label, fitted and early-stopped WITHOUT LIRF rows (--exclude-airports LIRF; runs/adsb_full_nolirf); seasonal and forward folds give out-of-sample predictions for Jan/Jul and Nov 2025; the refit on the eleven 2025 months at the median best iteration predicts the ranking. The derived feature adsb_full_minus_v9 is added by attach_extra.

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.recipe: v12 = v9 + 1.0 * ADS-B surface residual with neighbour features on matched rows outside LIRF (configs/adsb_v12_v2.json, nb_no_lirf_100)

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after v12 scored 246.4831 officially (3rd of 144; 2nd 245.2932, 1st 245.0207). Two full-data learner variants were fitted before this declaration (docs/adsb_full/README.md): with all airports (early stopping after ~225 rounds, LIRF dominating the RMSE) and without LIRF (1,419 rounds on the seasonal fold). The no-LIRF learner alone, on Jan / Jul 2025, beats v9 at the covered airports (Jan: EDDF 140 vs 178, EDDM 112 vs 168, EHAM 162 vs 198, LEBL 98 vs 144, LSZH 176 vs 207) and even v12 at EHAM/LEBL in Jan (162 vs 167, 98 vs 105), is slightly worse than v9 on unmatched rows (LTFM 226 vs 222) and useless at LIRF (1,230 / 2,157 s). A fixed 50/50 blend with the v12 development predictions on non-LIRF rows gives -0.3% / -0.1% (Jan / Jul); a learned stack should do better and avoid the unmatched-row losses. No number for the stacked residual existed before this declaration. Expected size on the ranking: 0.3-1%.

residual_model.applies_to: the candidate's scope, for training and prediction alike; every row outside the scope keeps the v9 prediction exactly. LIRF stays excluded (see v12_v2); the full-data learner is catastrophic there (Jan 802 s vs v9 408 s)
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF (matched or not); the full-data learner predicts every row
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF)

configuration.selection: For each candidate (scope, weight), RMSE of (v9 + weight * residual on the scope) on each held-out month versus the v12 development prediction on the same rows (all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v12 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0) and its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.997. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v12; otherwise select nothing. Ratios to v9, per-airport tables and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v12 are descriptive only.
